# LifeWell documentation — Zaions and the developer

LifeWell keeps the people and moments of your life in one place. Ahsan Mahmood built it after listening to his parents tell the stories of their lives.

- [About the developer](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/about-developer): the vision and dated LifeWell milestones.
- [Products from Zaions](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem): the other products from the same maker.

## Other products
- [AchatAI](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/achat): Find someone without asking for their number. Official site: https://achat.aoneahsan.com
- [CallVault](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/callvault): A call you can find and listen to later. Official site: https://callvault.aoneahsan.com
- [Capacitor Auth Manager](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/capacitor-auth-manager): One Google sign-in call across web and native apps. Official site: https://www.npmjs.com/package/capacitor-auth-manager
- [ClearHire](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/clearhire): Put your work history into a structured resume. Official site: https://clearhire.aoneahsan.com
- [Eat This](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/eatthis): Look for food by nutrient, feeling or time of day. Official site: https://eatthis.aoneahsan.com/
- [Empora](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/empora): Choose the WooCommerce modules your store needs. Official site: https://empora.aoneahsan.com
- [HabitForge](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/habitforge): A check-in becomes a rope you can see. Official site: https://habitforge.aoneahsan.com
- [LabFlow](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/labflow): Keep a lab order with its sample and result. Official site: https://labflow.aoneahsan.com
- [linux-cleanup](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/linux-cleanup): See each path before Linux cleanup touches it. Official site: https://linux-cleanup.aoneahsan.com/
- [macleanup](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/macleanup): Preview macOS cleanup before choosing it. Official site: https://github.com/aoneahsan/macleanup
- [Native Update](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/native-update): Deliver a Capacitor bundle without waiting for a store release. Official site: https://nativeupdate.aoneahsan.com
- [NetCage](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/netcage): Choose which Android apps can use the network. Official site: https://netcage.aoneahsan.com
- [PregnancyPal](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/pregnancypal): Keep the changing weeks of pregnancy together. Official site: https://pregnancypal.aoneahsan.com
- [RentParty](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/rentparty): Pause a property game and keep the deeds in place. Official site: https://rentparty.aoneahsan.com
- [SMS App](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/smsapp): Send a batch of messages from your Android device. Official site: https://smsapp.aoneahsan.com
- [Strata Storage](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/strata-storage): One interface for several places an app keeps data. Official site: https://www.npmjs.com/package/strata-storage
- [Tilawah](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/tilawah): Return to a Tajweed or Tafseer lesson at your pace. Official site: https://tilawah.aoneahsan.com
- [Trizlink](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/trizlink): Keep short links and a bio page together. Official site: https://trizlink.com
- [Video Controls Plus](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/video-controls-plus): Change the pace of an HTML5 video. Official site: https://vcpeai.aoneahsan.com
- [Waylock](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/waylock): Keep chosen stops in place on a driver route. Official site: https://waylock.aoneahsan.com
- [windowsweep](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/windowsweep): Read the Windows cleanup list before removing anything. Official site: https://windowsweep.aoneahsan.com
- [ZTools](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/ecosystem/ztools): Find a utility and run it in your browser. Official site: https://ztools.zaions.com
